title: Why is the sky blue?
voice_direction: Warm, curious, unhurried. Smile on the payoff.

beats.narration: [curious] Look up on a clear day. Why is the sky blue?
beats.visual_intent: Mote gazes up at a bright sky; the question appears.

beats.narration: Sunlight holds every colour. When it hits the tiny molecules of air, the short blue waves get scattered all over the sky.
beats.visual_intent: A white sunbeam strikes air molecules; blue rays spray outward while red passes straight on.

beats.narration: Blue scatters about six times more than red. That scattered light is the blue you see.
beats.visual_intent: A big ×5.9 stat counts up; Mote smiles under a blue sky.
